featured_reviews.name: Rayhan achwa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience at Fat Kong, Jogeshwari West.

Despite specifically requesting a simple meal modification for a child, the staff completely ignored the request. When dining with children, basic customer requests should be taken seriously, but unfortunately that was not the case here.

What was even more concerning was the noticeable decline in food quality. The food lacked the freshness and taste that Fat Kong was once known for. Portions and presentation were below expectations, and the overall dining experience felt far from the standards the restaurant used to maintain.

Cleanliness has also deteriorated significantly. The dining area and overall upkeep gave an impression of poor maintenance and lack of attention to hygiene, which is unacceptable for any restaurant.

This used to be a place I would happily recommend, but after this visit, I am extremely disappointed. Management needs to urgently address customer service, food quality, and cleanliness before more loyal customers are lost.

featured_reviews.review_text: I was quite disappointed with the food here. The taste was very bland and lacked flavor, which was unexpected. Considering the prices, I expected much better quality. featured_reviews.name: Manish Bansal
featured_reviews.review_text: Fat kong never fails to impress you with their great food. Decades old place still serves one of the best local Chinese at reasonable rates and great quantity. We ordered Burnt garlic pot rice which was super delicious. The veggies in Oyster sauce was also yum. Veg Hakka noodles were good too. Must have place

featured_reviews.name: Anas Patanwala
featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointing experience. The staff lacks basic courtesy and speaks to customers as if they’re doing us a favor by serving food, which is completely unacceptable. I ordered crispy threaded chicken online, and when I asked for the usual sauces & condiments that are normally provided free when dining in the person on the call was incredibly rude and insisted I pay extra offline just to get them. What made it worse was the attitude: dismissive, arrogant, and disrespectful. On top of that, the food quality has clearly gone downhill over time. If a restaurant can’t respect its guests, it doesn’t deserve their business. You’re better off eating at a roadside stall where prices are lower and customers are treated with basic decency. Definitely not ordering from here again.

featured_reviews.name: Divya Nandurkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Really good Chinese food! The taste was amazing and the quantity was quite generous. Totally worth it if you're looking for good quality and value for money. Will definitely visit again!

featured_reviews.name: pompy Kanchan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosy Chinese is a hidden gem for sizzler lovers! The best part is that they serve a wide variety of sizzling platters under ₹500, making it great value for money. We tried their delicious Chicken Sizzler and loved how generously portioned and flavorful it was.

Apart from the sizzlers, their Chinese dishes were equally impressive. The Chicken Crispy was perfectly crunchy and packed with flavor, while the Kung Pao Chicken had the right balance of spice and sauce. They also offer plenty of options in veg, chicken, and prawn sizzlers, so there’s something for everyone.

Good food, reasonable pricing, and satisfying portions make this place worth visiting. Highly recommended for Chinese food and sizzler enthusiasts!

featured_reviews.name: Ramsha Tausalkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Oshiwara has a new Desi Chinese spot that’s super affordable and serving great food. Choosy Chinese has a cozy space with a menu that spells comfort food. They’re doing sizzlers best so don’t miss out on that one. We loved the Korean Chicken Wings, just look at that size. We also finished the Assorted Momo Platter in minutes, that had all 4 of their non veg momo options. If you’re looking for a new Desi Chinese spot in the area, check this out.

featured_reviews.name: Ask Ask
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great experience here! The food was absolutely delicious and full of flavor. The quality of ingredients was very good and everything tasted fresh. The service was quick and the staff were polite and welcoming. The ambiance was also nice and comfortable which made the whole dining experience even better. Definitely a place I would recommend to anyone looking for good food. Will surely visit again.

featured_reviews.name: Santoshi Gond
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried Choosy Chinese recently and had a really good experience overall 🍜

We ordered Crispy Chicken, Chicken Spring Roll, Chicken Fried Rice and Hakka Noodles. The quantity of chicken in most dishes was quite good considering the prices are very reasonable.

Our favourites were definitely the Crispy Chicken and Chicken Fried Rice both were full of flavour and really satisfying. The Chicken Spring Roll was average in taste and felt like it had less chicken filling compared to the other dishes.

The staff was friendly and welcoming which made the experience even better. Overall a good place for affordable Chinese food and worth trying 👍

featured_reviews.name: Maaz Memon
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved this Chinese restaurant! 🍜🥢

The food here is simply amazing — every dish was full of flavor, fresh, and perfectly cooked. The noodles were delicious, the starters were crispy and tasty, and the sauces had that authentic Chinese taste which is hard to find.

The ambience is very nice and comfortable, perfect for going with friends or family. The staff is polite, service is fast, and the presentation of food is also very good.

Overall, a great place for Chinese food lovers. Highly recommended, will definitely visit again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

featured_reviews.review_text:
Stomach on SV Road, Jogeshwari West offers a simple dining experience with good cleanliness and a decent atmosphere. The staff is polite and helpful, making the overall service satisfactory.

However, the Chinese food was quite average in terms of both taste and quality. If you are a fan of Chinese cuisine and have high expectations, you may find the food somewhat disappointing. The flavors were ordinary and did not stand out compared to other Chinese food options in the area.

Overall, the restaurant scores well on hygiene and service, but there is definitely room for improvement in food taste and quality. We hope the management works on enhancing the dining experience and delivering better value to customers.

featured_reviews.name: Shireen Fathima
featured_reviews.review_text: Pathetic experience. Although newly opened, the tables looked worn out.. cleanliness wasn’t maintained.. no glasses served. The servers were so unprofessional in their attire.. The takeaway was packed in plastic..

featured_reviews.name: Mansoor Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Stomach Oriental Chinese Restaurant on 27th June to celebrate my sister's birthday, expecting a memorable dining experience. Unfortunately, it turned out to be one of the most disappointing restaurant visits I've ever had.

The food was of an extremely poor standard and tasted as though it had been prepared by someone with little or no understanding of Chinese cuisine. The Chicken Salt & Pepper starter was a complete disaster—there was neither salt nor pepper, and instead of being dry and crispy as the name suggests, it arrived swimming in an unappetizing gravy. The Bangkok Crispy starter was equally disappointing, tasting almost identical to the previous dish, with only the shape being different.

The main course offered no improvement whatsoever. Every dish lacked flavour, freshness, and authenticity. It is difficult to understand how a restaurant serving food of such poor quality continues to operate.

This was supposed to be a special birthday celebration, but the terrible food completely ruined the occasion. I would strongly advise anyone considering dining here to save their money and go elsewhere. There are far better restaurants offering superior food, service, and value. My experience at Stomach Oriental Chinese Restaurant was nothing short of regrettable, and I certainly will not be returning.

featured_reviews.name: Miura
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered the Butter Chicken Meal Box from this restaurant, and it turned out to be an excellent experience—especially considering I received it on an offer for under ₹200. The packaging was neat and secure, reflecting good attention to detail.

The meal itself was perfect for one person and included butter chicken, two tandoori rotis, a portion of chicken kebab, two small gulab jamuns, a flavourful chutney, onion and lemon slices, and even a small soft drink bottle. Both the kebab and the butter chicken were exceptionally well-prepared—rich, tender, and truly satisfying.

For such a pocket-friendly price, this meal felt like remarkable value for money. I thoroughly enjoyed the food and would gladly order it again.

featured_reviews.name: Ands Fabrication
featured_reviews.review_text:
If disappointment had a taste, it would be exactly like the food at Al Ayamna.
We ordered the Barakas Thaal and Mutton Chaap Barra Tandoori, and honestly, I’m still wondering how this place is even in business. The mutton was so tough and rubbery, it felt like a jaw workout session rather than a meal. Freshness? Completely missing. Flavor? Nowhere to be found.
The so-called “special” thaal was a joke—bland, poorly cooked, and absolutely not worth even half the price. The rotis were dry and lifeless, like they were made in the afternoon and served at night without any shame.
And let’s talk about pricing—₹3600+ for this? For what exactly? Bad food and regret?
This place is all hype and zero quality. If you enjoy wasting money and testing your patience, go ahead. Otherwise, do yourself a favor and stay far away.
One visit was more than enough. Never again.

featured_reviews.name: Adil khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst. Avoid Al Ayamna at all costs.

We found a sharp metal wire-like object in the mutton pulao we ordered. This is not just bad service — it’s a serious health hazard that could have caused injury.

This clearly shows poor hygiene standards and complete negligence in food preparation. Such incidents are unacceptable and dangerous.

I strongly urge others to think twice before dining here. This place needs strict quality control and accountability.

featured_reviews.name: Tony Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A must-visit for mutton lovers! 🍖🔥

We had an absolutely fantastic experience here! We ordered the Ertugul Thaal, and it was truly massive easily enough for 6–7 people. Every item in the thaal was packed with rich flavors and perfectly cooked. If you love mutton, this is something you definitely cannot miss! 🤩

We also tried the Special Fruit Champagne 🍹 and it was super refreshing and delicious a perfect drink to go along with such a heavy and flavorful meal.

The place has a really nice vibe and is perfect to enjoy with family and friends 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦✨.

There was a small confusion with our starters we had ordered veg but were served non-veg by mistake. But the owner was extremely polite and understanding and quickly got it replaced without any hesitation. Great hospitality! 👏

Overall, the food, quantity, taste, and service were all amazing. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a place to enjoy a grand meal with your group! 🔥🍽️

owner_posts.post_text:
Iftar cravings sorted! ✅
Chicken Arabian ya Chicken Barbeque? Sab kuch hai ekdum lajawab. New Skyway mein milte hain Iftar ke waqt. 🌙🥘

Iss Ramadan, Iftar ki tayari ka tension chhodo aur New Skyway ke saath sukoon se roza kholo! ✨ Hum le kar aaye hain khaas 'Noor' aur 'Barkat' Iftar Boxes, jo aapke ghar ki dawat mein chaar chaand laga denge.

​Order karne ke liye abhi call karein: 
9702526329 / 9892872531

Doston ke saath outing ho ya family dinner, New Skyway ka Chicken Boxer Rice hamesha hit rehta hai. Iska unique taste aur woh mast omelet topping... maza aa gaya! 😍
​Location: Jogeshwari (West)
Tag your food partner! 🍴
"Spices ka asli jadoo! ✨ New Skyway ka Mutton Angara – tender, smoky, aur bilkul lajawab. Agar aap Jogeshwari mein hain aur ye nahi try kiya, toh kya kiya? 🌶️🍖"

"Grill pe gaya, Dil pe chha gaya! ❤️
New Skyway ki ye Chicken Barra Tandoori try nahi ki toh kya kiya? Truly the best Mughlai experience in Jogeshwari! 🍗🔥"
"Tandoori Vibes Only! 🔥 New Skyway ke juicy Chicken Seekh Kababs are calling you. Aaj ka dinner set hai? 😉

"Zayka wahi, andaaz naya hai, ✨
New Skyway ki har dish mein ek alag hi nasha hai.
Ye Lemon Tandoori nahi, bas thoda sa pyaar hai,
Iske aage toh saara shehar bekar hai!"

"Smoky hai baahar se, andar se hai rasila, 🔥🍋
Skyway ka Lemon Tandoori hai sabse nashila!
Swaad aisa ki dil garden-garden ho jaye,
Aur har foodie bas dekhta hi reh jaye."

Mughlai ki Rani" — Butter Chicken at its best! 👑✨
Agar aapne New Skyway Restaurant ka ye creamy aur delicious Butter Chicken nahi try kiya, toh aapne kuch miss kar diya hai. Swad aisa jo dil jeet le!

Jogeshwari ka asli maza ab aapki thali mein! 🥘 New Skyway Restaurant ka ye Iconic Bombay Green Keema sirf ek dish nahi, ek ehsas hai. Mutton ka sahi texture aur hari mirch-dhaniye ka wo purana jaadu. Aaj hi aaiye aur lijiye asli Mughlai ka lutf!

featured_reviews.name: Pranay Anthwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
What a super super super restaurant. We knew its a genuine place having ordered once or twice before but today I got my 2 cooks and driver and we came to New Skyway at 715 pm. We got seating and the service over all was top notch.

We ordered
- 1 butter chicken 10/10
- 1 chicken biryani 10/10
- 3 butter naan 9/10
- 1 yellow dal tadka 11/10
- 3 chaas 9/10

Out of the world food.  And the bill was a modest 1192.

Aslam bhai & Ashfaq are awesome and Raees who served us was so sweet and courteous and prompt.

This is a must visit for foodies but try reaching around 7/730 else I can assume a waiting for sometime. Though they have an ac section on first floor and a neat clean washroom too.

God bless these sweet people and more power to them.

Pranay

featured_reviews.name: Asad Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
The place is well designed and is suited for all kinds of customers. It has two section one with AC and one without it but both can be used by all kinds of customers. The interiors is designed well and the place is very well lit.

The menu is vast and has numerous dishes in both Chinese and Mughlai cuisine.

The taste varied from dish to dish but in short according to me the Chinese cuisine was good to taste but Mughlai dishes were okay and to be more specific the Chicken Mughlai dishes tasted good like Butter Chicken but the mutton dishes were average.
Overall, the taste is decent.

The quantity is good and the pricing is acceptable. The place isn't very expensive.

The service is slow and that needs attention in my opinion.
